title: Anchor Date of a Mailed Certification Form (Occupancy and Residency Certification)
content:
A mailed certification form recorded on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile has an **anchor date**, chosen as follows:

| Records | Anchor date |
|---|---|
| a return notice is on file and the form's signature date is earlier than the return date | the return date — the form attests occupancy only from the day the signer was back home |
| no return notice is on file and the signature date is earlier than the date the form was received | the date the form was received |
| every other case | the signature date the form states |

The return notice is the accepted return-home notice about the primary borrower received most recently, and the return date is the date it states.

*Hypothetical cases.* A form signed before the return date stated on the borrower's return notice has the return date as its anchor. With no return notice on file, a form signed on one day and received a week later has its receipt date as its anchor.
